text: ★★★★★★☆☆☆☆ You would not expect much from such a budget game... wrong! Polarity seems like Portal. As a small studio product it cannot enjoy high end polishing and voice acting, but in the puzzle and game mechanic department it lacks nothing; in fact Polarity brings some innovative ideas, you would not find in Portal. Great concept, nicely developed and thought over. Steady pace of learning, which never gets confusing; however the game is not afraid to shock with original solutions. A feast for players, who enjoyed Portal. Sounds and music fitting and ejoyable. You will no regret buying this game and a challenge it brings, will bind you to the screen and reward you with surprisingly high amount of satisfaction.

Picking characters; Now  I have zero complaints about the Dino's but the when Picking a Human Mainly everyone picks the Tracker with the Shotgun.  Why?  Because when someones playing a Dinosaur they are pretty much in your face the entire time, so picking a long range charater isn't necessary. 3.  This is just a thought really:  Dino's are easy to spot with humans (except for the flyers sometimes)  but when playing a Dino hunting a human unless they are running around can be hard to spot.  If your playing a Dinosaur shouldn't they be able to smell you if close enough? Unless fatigued I would think if a human is hiding behind a rock or crate you should have a dino's senses go off for a split second.
